chapter: Los Angeles scene, Tatum and Billy Berg's
title: Third marriage to Patricia, the dogs and recent dates
summary: He married Patricia in his house eleven years ago, and has played dates with Johnny Otis, Eddie Vinson and Joe Houston.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: When was it that you got married for the third time?
Got married right here in my house. Been eleven years ago. Married Patricia right here. I'm with her now, an' we been doin' pretty good. We got a dog...

...called Silver. 'Course we had another dog named Rhythm. Somebody stole him. An'...uh, we had him for eleven years. So when they stole him, we got the other little dog called Silver. That's the one was playin' with you.

An' we been in an' out...have...have played some dates with Johnny Otis's band...me and Eddie Vinson "Cleanhead"...an' I played some dates with Joe Houston...Joe Houston and his Sorrelles (?) Quartet...have a bunch o' girls called Sorrelles (?). We played with them. And then...went out an' played California here a long time ago. Gittin' back behind now.
